rows.grounds: optative verb expressing prescribed ritual action
instrumental expressing the manner of offering
numeral specifying the quantity of offerings

items.question: What specific daily oblation practice is prescribed to secure the stated benefits?
premises: Oblations should be performed on a daily basis.
The oblations must be performed with devotion.
A thousand blooming and auspicious items are to be offered.
items.inference: A devoted daily offering of a thousand blooming auspicious items constitutes the prescribed ritual practice.
uncertainties: The offered items are implied to be flowers but not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should daily offer a thousand oblations with devotion using blooming, auspicious flowers.
